reason: Runnable (<2 CPU-min with gp/cypari2/numpy; p~2^17, r~p, O(r) per curve; I checked the exact identity x(jP)-x_P=-psi_{j-1}psi_{j+1}/psi_j^2 on 2998/2998 j at p=180181 prime order r=179833, and Delta^2 of the l=13 character-index sequence of psi_{k-1}/psi_k is uniform (max bin 271/2996 vs 230 expected), i.e. null behaviour). Defects as written: (1) no null/control arm and no positive control, so a negative cannot be distinguished from a broken pipeline; (2) the alpha^{k^2}beta^k fit search is wasteful and the k<r range has no quasi-period to see (quasi-periodicity psi_{k+r}=a*b^k*psi_k only acts across k->k+r, and psi_r(P)=0 for prime-order P, so the pole/zero at k=1 and k=r must be excluded explicitly); the equivalent exact test is constancy of the second difference of the discrete-log index c_k=ind_l(psi_{k-1}/psi_k) in Z/l (alpha^{k^2}beta^k gives Delta^2=const), generalisable to Delta^{d+1}=const for degree d<=4; (3) 'gcd(r,p-1)=1' is vacuous for prime r>p-1-ish, the real constraint is l|p-1 (choose p=1 mod 30030, p in 2^17..2^18); (4) threshold 5/sqrt(r) ignores trial count and l-dependence of sigma=sqrt((1/l)(1-1/l)/r) - use z-scores with Bonferroni over (curves x l x degrees); (5) metric is a structural quantity (agreement fraction / z) not wall time: OK; (6) scaling: toy cannot speak to n=131/130-bit. It only supports 'no low-degree law in k'; sensitivity floor 5/sqrt(r)~1.2-2% at r=2^16-2^18 and vanishes at r~2^130, so it is a toy-only artefact for the structural claim. The ECDLP-relevant gap is not tested at all: the test uses known k, whereas an attacker needs chi_l(U(Q)) from Q alone, and U(Q)=C*psi_{k-1}/psi_k needs k (= the DLP; GGM-simulable per KN-FIND-002). So even a positive result would not be an algorithm; the idea's expected_class 'accounting' stands. Scaling argument that is honest: identity is size-independent (algebraic, proven by telescoping); pseudorandomness claim is supported by showing |z| statistics ~N(0,1) with no r-dependent drift across p=2^12..2^20.
fix: Redesign: (A) Identity arm: for 5 prime-order curves, p=1 mod 30030 in [2^17,2^18], compute U(kP) two ways, (i) cocycle product prod_{j=2}^{k} c/(x(jP)-x_P) with PARI elladd, (ii) psi_{k-1}(P)/psi_k(P) via EDS recurrence; assert equality for all 2<=k<=r-1 up to the constant C and sign (-1)^{...}; list excluded poles k=1,r. (B) Structure arm: for each l in {2,3,5,7,11,13} dividing p-1, c_k=ind_l(U(kP)) in Z/l; for degree d=1..4 compute D=Delta^{d+1} c_k mod l and report modal-bin fraction and z=(frac-1/l)/sqrt((1/l)(1-1/l)/r); also lag-1..64 autocorrelation of exp(2 pi i c_k/l) and chi^2 of c_k. Pass if all |z|<4.5 after Bonferroni. (C) Null arm: same pipeline on (i) a random permutation of k, (ii) i.i.d. uniform Z/l sequence, (iii) chi_l(x(kP)) and chi_l(y(kP)) (known exhausted coordinate-bias hunts) - expected z~N(0,1). (D) Positive controls: (i) planted c_k=(a k^2+b k+noise-free) mod l must give frac=1; (ii) planted with 2% corruption must be detected at z>5 (calibrates sensitivity floor); (iii) a curve with a point of small order m (e.g. m=7..13, p~2^17, not prime order) over k in [1,10m]: psi_k is exactly quasi-periodic, so Delta^2 structure over k mod m should show up as frac~1 for the quadratic-exponential fit. (E) Scaling arm: repeat for p in {2^12,...,2^20} and report max|z| vs log r, plus empirical minimum detectable bias; state explicitly that this bounds only bias >~5/sqrt(r), not 130-bit behaviour. (F) Add the missing ECDLP-relevant control: counted-operation check that computing chi_l(U(Q)) for Q=kP with unknown k, using only group ops on Q, P, costs the DLP (cite GGM simulation); no experiment is needed, but record it as the reason expected_class is accounting. Cost ~1-3 CPU-min total.
